bagPolicy.summary: Bags may not be larger than 21 cm x 30 cm x 10 cm (A4 format). Large handbags, backpacks, and luggage are not allowed.
allowed: Bags up to 21 cm x 30 cm x 10 cm
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Visitors to Lotto Arena can park for free at P+R Linkeroever, P+R Luchtbal, and P+R Merksem, which all have direct tram connections to the venue. Your event ticket also serves as a valid ticket for De Lijn public transport.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Lotto Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Lotto Arena offers a variety of food and drink options with bars and vending machines available on multiple levels. Drinks are served in reusable cups to reduce waste. Nearby restaurants include Pizzalijn Merksem and Pampas Rodizio.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Lotto Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Lotto Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Lotto Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance to the Lotto Arena is accessible via the street.
